GitHub Action to set up 1 GiB and 2 MiB huge pages

# Purpose
This composite action prepares the system for shared memory tests by resetting and reinitializing the `fd_shmem_cfg` setup, unmounting any existing `hugetlbfs` mounts, and then allocating the requested number of huge and gigantic pages. It uses the `count_huge` and `count_gigantic` inputs to compare the current page counts under `/sys/devices/system/node/node0/hugepages/` and only allocates more pages when the current count is lower than the requested value. The action also sets ownership on `/mnt/.fd` so the current user can access the mounted storage after setup.
